claims: Artemis II successfully launched on April 1, 2026, at 22:35 UTC from Launch Complex 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
Artemis II's crewed Orion spacecraft is conducting a 10-day lunar flyby mission.
Artemis II intends to return to Earth with a splashdown in the Pacific Ocean around April 11, 2026.
As of April 1, 2026, Artemis II is currently in orbit/en route to the Moon.
Artemis II's mission goal is a ~10-day crewed lunar flyby (no landing) with a Pacific Ocean splashdown.
The crew of Artemis II is Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The launch of Artemis II was primarily visible from Florida and parts of southern Georgia.
